BiblicalUsage: The oven is the smoking furnace that passed between Abraham's pieces when God cut His covenant, the oven where the grain offering was baked, and the furnace of the day that shall burn as an oven. It is an everyday thing, a cooking fire, and also the picture of God's judgment and His presence.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same fire that bakes bread can carry God's presence, and the oven that warms a home is the picture of the day that will burn up the proud.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
